en.heroIntro: I am Yingying Li, a psychological counselor and research assistant based in Leuven, Belgium. I hold a master’s degree from National Taiwan University, where I focused on developmental psychology. My research experience spans school-based social-emotional learning, trauma-informed group interventions, and university mental health programs. Drawing on both research and counseling practice, I am interested in how and for whom psychological interventions support meaningful change, particularly in self-concept, self-esteem, and well-being during emerging adulthood. I aim to use longitudinal and person-centered methods to understand individual pathways of change and inform more responsive, accessible psychological support.
